cat > /root/cost-verify-agent-rl/RAGEN/config/_alfworld_exp022_grpo_from_sft_v4.yaml << 'YAML_EOF'
defaults:
  - base

hydra:
  searchpath:
    - pkg://verl.trainer.config

model_path: /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/qwen3_exp021_ragen_sft_v4

system:
  CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES: "0,1"

micro_batch_size_per_gpu: 1
ppo_mini_batch_size: 32

trainer:
  project_name: cost-verify-agent-rl
  experiment_name: exp022-alfworld-grpo-from-sft-v4
  total_training_steps: 30
  n_gpus_per_node: 2
  val_before_train: True
  test_freq: 20
  save_freq: 5
  local_log_dir: "/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp022/"
  default_local_dir: "/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp022/"
  logger: ['console']
  max_actor_ckpt_to_keep: 3
  resume_mode: "disable"

actor_rollout_ref:
  model:
    override_config:
      attn_implementation: sdpa
  actor:
    use_ref: True
    use_torch_compile: False
    use_kl_loss: True
    kl_loss_coef: 0.1
    kl_loss_type: kl
    clip_ratio_low: 0.2
    clip_ratio_high: 0.28
    loss_agg_mode: "seq-mean-token-mean"
    grad_clip: 1.0
    optim:
      lr: 5e-7
  ref:
    use_torch_compile: False
  rollout:
    response_length: 1024
    gpu_memory_utilization: 0.4
    max_model_len: 8192
    temperature: 1.0
    max_num_batched_tokens: 8192
    enforce_eager: True
    val_kwargs:
      do_sample: True
      temperature: 0.4

algorithm:
  adv_estimator: grpo
  gamma: 0.95
  high_level_gamma: 0.95
  norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: True

agent_proxy:
  max_turn: 30
  max_actions_per_turn: 1
  max_prompt_length: 4096

collapse_detection:
  multi_turn_enabled: false

es_manager:
  format_penalty: 0
  train:
    env_groups: 4
    group_size: 16
    env_configs:
      tags: ["AlfworldSG"]
      n_groups: [4]
  val:
    env_groups: 4
    group_size: 1
    env_configs:
      tags: ["AlfworldSG"]
      n_groups: [4]
YAML_EOF
echo "Config written OK"

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/cost-verify-agent-rl && python3 -c "
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
import torch
path = '/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/qwen3_exp021_ragen_sft_v4'
print('Loading tokenizer...')
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(path, trust_remote_code=True)
print(f'Tokenizer OK: vocab_size={tok.vocab_size}')
print('Loading model...')
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(path, torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, device_map='cpu', trust_remote_code=True)
print(f'Model OK: {sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())/1e6:.1f}M params')
del model
print('READY for GRPO')
"
